note: Public-domain books and Golden Age comics from the Internet Archive, for the Video Club's reading shelf. Every entry was live-checked against the Archive metadata API (exists, viewable files, not lending-restricted). Manga: no verifiably public-domain manga was found on the Archive — the Archive's manga holdings are overwhelmingly copyrighted scanlations, so the manga shelf stays empty rather than filled with them. The Reading Room shows it as its checked public-domain shelves (books, Golden Age comics, and the manga shelf with the note below) and opens each item in its own reader; an item with no page images opens on archive.org. A note in this file does not change the copyright status of anything in it.

gaps.manga: No verifiably public-domain manga was found. The Archive's manga holdings (12,000+ items under subject:manga, including Boruto, Pokemon Adventures, Azumanga Daioh) are copyrighted scanlations, some carrying self-asserted CC0/public-domain tags from uploaders — a tag does not make a commercial manga public domain. The personal catalog (outside the repo) lists some of these for the owner's own TV with honest rights notes.
